metadata.title: Mobile Lifecycle

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing the lifecycle states of mobile devices accessing institutional services, including enrollment, suspension, and retirement.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile device lifecycle management, enrollment systems, selective wipe, full wipe, and access revocation mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining controlled lifecycle transitions for mobile devices without conferring execution trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Lifecycle aligns with NIST guidance on lifecycle management, access control, and Zero Trust revocation.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Lifecycle defines the permitted lifecycle states and transitions for mobile devices. This pattern ensures mobile access is explicitly granted, reviewable, and revocable, and that institutional data can be securely removed as risk or ownership changes.

components.title: Mobile Device Enrollment
components.description: Controls the initial onboarding of mobile devices into institutional trust frameworks.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of unauthorized or unmanaged devices to gain access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal enrollment ensures devices are known and attributable.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Devices are identified and authenticated prior to access.
An inventory of authorized mobile devices is maintained.

components.title: Mobile Access Suspension
components.description: Allows rapid suspension of mobile access when devices become non‑compliant or high‑risk.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Continued access using stale or revoked trust contexts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access revocation prevents over‑reliance on outdated posture.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access can be disabled when conditions change.
Mobile access is restricted based on dynamic risk.

components.title: Mobile Data Remediation
components.description: Ensures institutional data can be selectively or fully removed from mobile devices as part of lifecycle transitions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Retention of sensitive data after loss of authorization.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Selective and full wipe capabilities eliminate residual data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Baseline configurations include data removal mechanisms.

components.title: Mobile Device Decommissioning
components.description: Controls the formal retirement of mobile devices from institutional access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Secure wipe and access revocation prevent residual access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security safeguards cover system lifecycle termination.
